title: ARISE AND SHINE
THE MORNING LIGHT
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: soft sun rays through morning mist
golden light hitting pine forest canopy
slow motion ripples on a quiet lake
dew drops on leaves at sunrise
soft lens flare over a mountain peak

scenes.a: That sharp anxiety stirring in your chest right now is exactly where His light belongs.
Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the Lord rises upon you.
Lord, thank You for the truth that the darkness does not define this new day.
Help me to stand firmly in Your grace rather than retreating into the shadows today.
May Your presence brighten the path ahead and settle the frantic rhythm of my heart.
Guide my thoughts and my steps until the sun is high and my spirit rests.
